notifications.title: Three long videos are unlisted on YouTube but published on the dashboard
notifications.detail: Tonight's data audit (25 Oct 13:15 UTC) and the 22 Oct one both found L-20261021-01 (kYACrRwlx1s), L-20261019-02 (Y_qa18IDfm0) and L-20261018-01 (NxoAcDZWCh4) unlisted on YouTube. Not a code bug: the dashboard's state comes from the upload record, and YouTube reports the privacy you set in Studio. Unlisted videos get almost no views (1-2 each so far), and they count as published in the dashboard's totals and the agents' metrics. L-20261023-01 is public.
notifications.fix:
1. If they should be public: YouTube Studio → Content → each video → Visibility → Public. The next audit clears the warning.
2. If they are meant to stay unlisted (for example held back on purpose): on each video's dashboard page use Remove, so they stop counting as published videos.
